Interface Formal

All Superinterfaces:

All Known Subinterfaces:

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractComposite, AbstractDComposite, AbstractDescribed, AbstractFormal, Composite, DComposite, DPrimitive, Implication, Primitive
public interface Formal extends Comparable<Formal>
Formal representation of a mathematical 'primitive', an 'atomary entity', an undivisible mathematical 'thing' .
